models_evaluated: AI-enabled ECG mortality risk model (AI-ECG alert)

links.outcome: 90-day all-cause mortality with AI-ECG alert versus usual care
links.effect: 90-day mortality 3.6% intervention vs 4.3% control (HR 0.83, 95% CI 0.70-0.99); high-risk ECG subgroup HR 0.69 (0.53-0.90); cardiac death 0.2% vs 2.4% (HR 0.07).
links.quote: The trial met its primary outcome, finding that implementation of the AI-ECG alert was associated with a significant reduction in all-cause mortality within 90 days: 3.6% patients in the intervention group died within 90 days, compared to 4.3% in the control group (4.3%) (hazard ratio (HR) = 0.83, 95% confidence interval (CI) = 0.70-0.99).
